nodes.name: Approved Live Work
nodes.notes: Called by the backend after a live_pin or live_arm approval has moved PENDING -> APPROVED. Set N8N_LIVE_WEBHOOK_URL to this path.

nodes.name: Already Done?
nodes.notes: A Facebook basket needs no call: it is already reported as pinned, because the host reading it out is the whole mechanism.

nodes.name: Report The Basket
nodes.notes: An item the platform refused is reported FAILED with its reason, not skipped — a basket that quietly lost an item sells nothing and nobody finds out until the host calls for it.

nodes.name: Tell The Floor It Is Live
nodes.notes: 423 if nobody armed it or it was paused. The backend will not let a workflow put a session live that a human has not approved.

nodes.name: Every Twenty Seconds
nodes.notes: A live room moves fast. Twenty seconds is close enough to answer a claim while the host is still on the item, and slow enough not to spend the platform’s rate limit on an empty room.

nodes.name: Record The Sample
nodes.notes: The monitor on the dashboard is drawn from these rows, so it survives the tab being closed — same rule as everything else here.

nodes.name: Read It For Buy Intent
nodes.notes: The backend does the reading, holds the stock and hands back the one sentence a human approved. 423 means paused or not armed, and the comment is left alone.

nodes.name: Say It In The Room
nodes.notes: Where the line actually goes depends on the room: a TikTok Live reply, a Messenger DM, or a comment reply. Point LIVE_REPLY_WEBHOOK_URL at whichever sender you use; unset, it no-ops and the claim is still recorded with its link so the host can read it out.

nodes.name: Put Back What Was Not Paid
nodes.notes: A hold nobody paid for goes back on the shelf, so the next viewer who asks can actually have it instead of being told it is gone by a ghost.
